newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-TAYLOR WINS THE TOSS AND BATS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TAYLOR WINS THE TOSS AND BATS.

text.p: Australia captain Mark Taylor won the toss and elected to bat in the fifth and final test against West Indies at the WACA Ground on Saturday.
Australia, who have already won the series after taking an unassailable 3-1 lead, named batsman Justin Langer as 12th man.
West Indies welcomed back fast bowler Curtly Ambrose, who missed the fourth test in Adelaide because of injury.
In his absence, the tourists slumped to an innings defeat in their worst test loss in 40 years.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Hayden, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Andrew Bichel, Paul Reiffel, Glenn McGrath, Justin Langer 12th man.

West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Robert Samuels, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Phil Simmons, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Roland Holder 12th man
